avis.titre: Great for blemish-prone skin — clean, fresh, and effective!
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Vichy Normaderm Intensive Purifying Cleanser for a few weeks, and it has quickly become one of my favourite skincare products. My skin is blemish-prone and can get oily in the T-zone, but also sensitive — so finding something that cleans deeply without irritating is a challenge. This cleanser hits the perfect balance. The formula with salicylic acid and zinc really helps keep breakouts under control. After washing, my skin feels properly clean and purified but never stripped or tight. I’ve noticed fewer new blemishes and less shine throughout the day, which is a huge win. The texture lathers nicely, the scent is fresh and not overpowering, and the 200ml bottle lasts longer than expected since you only need a small amount. If you struggle with clogged pores or recurring breakouts, I definitely recommend giving this a try. It’s gentle, effective, and genuinely improves the look and feel of blemish-prone skin.
I’ve been using this for a while and have noticed fewer breakouts. It cleanses well, doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy, and makes my face feel fresh and clean. Highly recommend!
